raise_justifications.desktop/macos/Desktop/Sources/Providers/: Adds `revokeActiveTurn(reason:)`, extracted from `stopAgent`, and routes the three transcript resets through it. Those resets blanked `messages` while leaving `isSending` true, `activeTurnOwner` set and the send lock held, so every later send was rejected as "already sending", Stop could not clear it, and the abandoned turn's late result still ran the visible-completion path against rows that no longer existed — a turn that silently vanished while telemetry and the success chime reported success. INV-6 requires one revocation authority in this type: moving it out would give an in-flight turn two owners, which is the defect.

Canonical goal reads and creation plus owner-scoped Rewind evidence remain beside the existing authorized tool dispatch and sharing-policy boundary; the new create path validates required fields, binds writes to the authenticated owner, and returns bounded tool errors. update_action_item accepts the realtime `id` alias and backend task writes refresh TasksStore so agent-created tasks appear immediately; permission opens and local-file scans both stay bound to their authorized owner. Swift 6: explicit @preconcurrency import ApplicationServices for AX APIs used by tool execution path.
